system.description:
You are a legacy of one of the most infamous debacles since the Fall. As a member of the “Lost generation,” you went through an accelerated-growth childhood, somehow surviving where others of your kind died, went insane, or were persecuted (see The Lost, p. 233). Your background is a social stigma, but it does provide you with certain advantages ... and burdens.

Advantages: +20 to two Knowledge skills of your choice, Psi trait (Level 1) Disadvantages: Mental Disorder (choose two , this includes the one from Psi) trait, Social Stigma (Lost) trait, must start with Futura morph Common Morphs: Futuras

Source: Eclipse Phase Core Rulebook, p. 131.
system.choices: +20 to two Knowledge skills of your choice; Mental Disorder: choose two , this includes the one from Psi; Social Stigma: Lost
